name: sl-ui-library
description: Find real SL UI components, adapt their palette and integrate bundled HTML/CSS/JavaScript or source-preserving React/Next.js adapters.

interface.shortDescription: Handcrafted components for your next interface.
interface.longDescription: Let the agent choose from 388 HTML, CSS and JavaScript components across ten categories, plus source-preserving React and Next.js adapters. Inspect real source, adapt your palette and integrate a complete package. The complete library works offline. Optional catalog updates require a published channel and explicit opt-in.

Build a compact project dialog for my app.
Choose suitable navigation for my dashboard.
